findings.summary: Graded Low: the criterion's character rule for environment and version accepts the contract's canary strings, so the script also requires the caller to pass the expected values; the issue text and #312 should say so.
Graded Low: refused extra labels and annotations are listed under the fixed words extra_label and extra_annotation rather than by field name, because the names come from the payload.
Graded Low: one failed poll exits 2 with no retry, and incident.json is written with no fsync.
Graded Low: the tests pin only two out-of-range startsAt values; the +14:00, -12:00 and one-minute offsets at the year limits are handled but not pinned.
